author: Elizabeth Leath
text: Oh my God These guys were awesome. I didnt know anything about septic systems. Bobby and his son Brian were super nice. Very professional. They found the system so fast I had no idea where it was. They cleaned out the septic, had me flush my toilet everything seems to work as before. The septic needed to be cleaned it hadn't been cleaned in yrs. We bought the property 3 yrs ago. I would definitely recommend them. Not only did they do their job but they also educated me on the system. You guys have a customer for life. Thanks again…..
